capabilities: Detect file encodings across 22 candidate encodings with confidence scores
Convert non-UTF-8 files to UTF-8 with automatic backup and rollback
Repair double-encoded mojibake with a before/after preview
Detect U+FFFD replacement characters and report unrecoverable damage
Export conversion logs as JSON or Markdown
disambiguation: Not a code formatter or language transpiler; it converts the character encoding of files, not their content or syntax.
extras: Freemium: folder batch conversion, the last 6 UI languages, and editing the extension whitelist require a VIP code; single-file conversion, detection, mojibake repair, logs, and backups are free. The mojibake repair command is experimental, and the linked user guide is currently Chinese only.
problem: Obsidian reads every note as UTF-8, so legacy-encoded files (GBK, Big5, Shift-JIS, UTF-16) open as garbage and can be silently re-saved as permanent mojibake.

requires.name: VIP activation code (via GitHub Sponsors or afdian.net)

summary: File encoding converter that detects non-UTF-8 files in a vault, converts them to UTF-8 with automatic backups, and repairs double-encoded mojibake.
